messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy unlikely past; laws, technology, and social resistance keep it alive, though erosion is plausible. Privacy
Consciousness copying by early 2030s is extremely unlikely because mapping, verifying, and replicating subjective experience remains far beyond current science. Consciousness
Internet availability everywhere by early 2030s is plausible in populated regions but less likely on remote oceans, deserts, and conflict zones due to infrastructure cost. Internet
Transport becoming fully electric eventually is plausible for cars and trains, but aviation and shipping make total electrification difficult. Transport
Climate change effects becoming irreversible is highly likely in some systems, though human intervention may slow or mitigate further damage. Climate
Money disappearing entirely is unlikely because cash resilience, privacy, and informal economies persist. Money
Genetics enabling centuries or immortality is highly unlikely; aging is complex, and radical life extension faces biological and ethical barriers. Genetics
